p88: 88.  In these circumstances, the Court considers that there were no ascertainable facts capable of raising doubts as to the impartiality of M.K., nor did the applicant have any legitimate reason to doubt it.
p89: 89.  The foregoing considerations are sufficient to enable the Court to conclude that there has been no violation of Article 6 § 1 of the Convention as regards the question of Judge M.K.’s impartiality.
